## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can JG Hall hold?
JG Hall seats around 600 guests, with 130 seats in the dining hall. The Adithi Mini Hall takes 125–150.

### Where is JG Hall?
No. 169/170, 3rd Main Road, Raghava Nagar, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does JG Hall have?
Fully air-conditioned, Generator & inverter backup, CCTV cameras, Passenger lift + service lift, Kitchen with all vessels, Lockable store room, 7 A/C rooms, Parking for 200 two-wheelers.

### How far is JG Hall from the airport?
About 10 minutes' drive from Chennai Airport, with good connections to the Metro.

### What functions can I hold at JG Hall?
Weddings, engagements, seemantham, birthday get-togethers and family gatherings.

### How do I check if JG Hall is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 72994 15161.
